theater: 加薩走廊與地中海沿岸

battle.name: 以色列—哈馬斯戰爭
battle.theater: 加薩走廊與地中海沿岸
battle.brief: 二〇二三年十月七日哈馬斯以火箭彈、巡航飛彈與地道突襲攻擊以色列南部，以軍其後分階段攻入加薩，並以海軍封鎖海岸、攔截人道船隊。卡面是一八六二年英國鐵甲艦，木殼包鐵使裝甲第一次比火砲更難對付，砲塔自此繞著防禦展開；其後裔是以色列海軍的「薩爾」級巡防艦，裝甲換成飛彈與雷達，封鎖線由它維繫。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰方大致由四層構成。以色列一方由國防軍統合陸軍、海軍、空軍與國土防衛司令部：南方司令部負責加薩正面，國土防衛司令部管加薩走廊邊境與後方城市，後勤總局與軍工局維持燃料、糧食與彈藥產能，海軍則執掌海上封鎖、攔截與登船檢查。哈馬斯一方以武裝分支「卡桑旅」為骨幹，加上加薩治安總局的武裝人員與各區民兵，開戰前以方估計其武裝總人數約三萬上下，其中作戰單位約一萬五千。二〇二三年十月八日之後，黎巴嫩真主黨自北面發動火箭攻擊，也門胡塞武裝自紅海攻擊商船，伊拉克境內什葉派民兵與敘利亞武裝亦作配合，等於以方在海陸空三面同時應戰。海上另有伊朗、黎巴嫩、也門等國以軍火與資金支援對方，聯合國安理會自二〇二三年十月起密集表決，卡塔爾、埃及與美國則輪流扮演斡旋者。
countriesEn: The belligerents can be read in four layers. On the Israeli side the defence forces integrate the army, navy, air force and home front command: Southern Command handles the Gaza front, the Home Front Command covers the Gaza border strip and the cities behind it, the logistics directorate and the ordnance plants keep fuel, rations and ammunition production running, and the navy runs the maritime blockade, interdictions and boardings. The Hamas side is built on the armed wing al-Qassam Brigades, together with the armed members of the Gaza security force and local militia; Israeli estimates put the total armed strength at around thirty thousand men before the war, of whom perhaps fifteen thousand belonged to combat units. From 8 October 2023 Hezbollah in Lebanon opened a second front from the north and the Houthi movement in Yemen attacked merchant shipping in the Red Sea, with Iraqi Shia militias and armed groups in Syria adding pressure, so that Israel was fighting on the land, at sea and in the air at once. At sea, sanctions, the Levant trade route and the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint all became strategic assets, while the United Nations Security Council passed a dense run of resolutions from October 2023 and Qatar, Egypt and the United States took turns as mediators.
people: 關鍵人物分處兩邊。以色列方面，總理內塔尼亞胡自二〇二二年起組閣，國防部長加利揚特在開戰初期主導大規模動員，二〇二四年十月的戰時內閣改組中由卡茨接任；以軍參謀長赫茲·哈勒維自二〇二三年十月起統籌全軍，二〇二四年十一月由班尼·甘茨接任，二〇二五年春再由艾森伯格接掌。哈馬斯方面，政治領袖伊斯梅爾·哈尼耶自二〇二四年七月三十一日在多哈住所遇襲身亡，武裝指揮官穆罕默德·代夫於二〇二五年七月三十一日在汗尤尼斯被擊殺，軍方發言人葉海亞·沙拉拉在停火後出任加薩過渡行政機構主席，哈立勒·海亞則代表哈馬斯參與人質與停火談判。美國一線由總統拜登、國務卿布林肯與國防部長奧斯汀推動，埃及、卡塔爾與聯合國特使在幕後穿梭。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fell on two sides. In Israel, Prime Minister Netanyahu has headed a government since 2022; Defence Minister Gallant directed the mass mobilisation at the start of the war and was replaced by Katz in the wartime reshuffle of October 2024; Chief of Staff Herzi Halevi commanded the whole force from October 2023, gave way to Benny Gantz in November 2024, and was in turn followed by Eisenberg in the spring of 2025. On the Hamas side, the political leader Ismail Haniyeh was killed in a strike on his residence in Doha on 31 July 2024, the military commander Mohammed Deif was killed in Khan Younis on 31 July 2025, the military spokesman Yahya al-Sarara took the chair of the transitional administration in Gaza after the ceasefire, and Khalil al-Hayya represented Hamas in the hostage and ceasefire talks. On the American side President Biden, Secretary of State Blinken and Defence Secretary Austin drove the diplomacy, with Egypt, Qatar and the United Nations envoy shuttling behind the scenes.
kits: 卡面是一八六二年英國鐵甲艦：木殼外包鐵甲帶，裝甲第一次比主砲更難對付，砲塔設計自此繞著防禦展開。到二〇二三年，這條血統在以色列海軍手上換了一副面孔：「薩爾」六級巡防艦裝有垂直發射系統與「巴拉克」系列飛彈，「沙爾達格」級快艇掛載「魚叉」與「海雀」反艦飛彈，「德沃拉」級承擔近岸巡邏；火控雷達改用艦載對空對海搜索雷達，可同時追蹤數百個海上目標。以軍地面主力是「梅卡瓦」四型坦克與「命名者」坦克，配「特羅菲」主動防護系統，並有「卡爾穆茲」自行榴彈炮與「鐵穹」、「大衛之弓」攔截系統，後者由海基雷達指引。哈馬斯一方則大量使用摩托車、皮卡改裝的技術車與地道，加「卡桑」火箭炮、裝了小馬達的「法塔」長程火箭與「朱爾達」巡航飛彈，並攜帶炸藥包、反裝甲地雷與自製無人機。海上攻防的骨幹是無人艇與飛彈：二〇二四年四月，加薩方向的反艦飛彈擊中以軍「亞穆克」巡邏艇，成為這場戰爭中最早被記錄的、由岸基反艦飛彈成功命中海軍艦艇的戰例。
kitsEn: The card shows a British ironclad of 1862: an iron skin laid over a wooden hull, the first time in naval history that armour was harder to defeat than the main gun, with turret design thereafter turning on defence. By 2023 that line of descent wore a different face in the Israeli navy: Sa'ar 6 class corvettes with vertical launch systems and Barak missiles, Shaldag class fast missile boats carrying Harpoon and Seasparrow anti-ship missiles, and Dvora class boats for coastal patrol; fire control had moved to shipborne combined air and surface search radars able to hold several hundred maritime tracks at once. On the ground the Israeli line was centred on Merkava Mark 4 and Namer tanks fitted with the Trophy active protection system, supported by the Karmatz self-propelled howitzer and by the Iron Dome and David's Bow interception batteries, the latter cued by sea-based radars. The Hamas side fielded motorcycles, pick-up trucks converted into technicals, tunnels, Qassam rocket launchers, Fattah long-range rockets fitted with small motors to stretch their range, and al-Jurdah cruise missiles, together with demolition charges, anti-tank mines and home-made drones. The spine of the sea fighting was unmanned boats and missiles: in April 2024 an anti-ship missile fired from Gaza struck the Israeli patrol boat Yarmouk, the earliest recorded case in this war of a shore-launched anti-ship missile scoring a confirmed hit on a naval vessel.
tactics: 作戰分三個階段。第一階段是二〇二三年十月七日那一日：哈馬斯以三千餘枚火箭彈、二十餘枚巡航飛彈配合無人機與地道突襲，同時在北部、東部與南部多點突破，以軍邊界防守單位被打散，裝甲與技術車被火砲直接命中，初日即有以軍將官陣亡。哈馬斯滲入者多走地道與海岸線，以軍隨後展開歷時數月的清剿地道行動。第二階段是二〇二三年十月至二〇二四年年底的縱深攻勢：以軍先以「清剿並佔領」方式奪取加薩城北面，再逐區推進，戰術上大量採用合圍殲滅、逐屋清理與工程作業配合空襲，並以「狼群」式無人地面車與遠程操控武器分擔風險。第三階段是海上與邊境：以色列海軍執行封鎖、攔截人道船隊與押走船上人員，數艘船在公海被登檢扣押；加薩北面的拉法口岸在二〇二四年十月再度關閉，境內持續以縱深打擊代替地面進攻。二〇二五年起局勢轉為停火框架下的間歇交火，北面與拉法走廊的陣地仍然對峙。
tacticsEn: The fighting ran in three phases. The first was the single day of 7 October 2023: Hamas fired some three thousand rockets and around twenty cruise missiles together with drones and tunnel assaults, breaking through on several axes in the north, east and south, while the Israeli border units were broken up and armour and technicals were destroyed outright by artillery, and Israeli commanders were killed on the very first day. Most of the infiltrators moved by tunnel and along the coast, and the army afterwards spent months clearing the tunnel network. The second phase ran from October 2023 to the end of 2024 as a drive into the interior: the army first took northern Gaza City by clearing and holding it, then advanced district by district, relying on encirclement, house-by-house clearance and engineering work combined with air strikes, and spreading the risk across Wolfpack unmanned ground vehicles and remotely operated weapons. The third phase was fought at sea and along the border: the Israeli navy enforced the blockade, intercepted relief flotillas and took men off ships, several of which were boarded and detained on the high seas; the Rafah crossing was closed again in October 2024 and deep strikes inside Gaza took the place of a ground advance. From 2025 the pattern settled into intermittent exchanges under the ceasefire framework, with the positions in the north and along the Rafah corridor still in confrontation.
data: 可核對的數字不少，但多數有爭議。開戰當日哈馬斯自加薩地帶發射約二千二百枚火箭彈，從西奈一帶另射約一千六百枚，另有二十枚左右巡航飛彈；初日以方公布的死亡與受傷總數逾一千二百人，其中軍警占數百人，其餘數字各方核對口徑不一。開戰前哈馬斯武裝總人數以方估計約三萬，以軍在加薩的兵力峰值常被估計在十萬上下。二〇二三年十月十七日至十八日加薩北面克拉姆沙洛姆路口一役，以軍第二百零一旅等部損失十三名士兵，為初日後最嚴重的一役。人質方面，初日被帶走二百五十一人，其後仍有一百二十人左右被扣押，至二〇二五年十月的協議框架下陸續獲釋。戰事曠日持久，至二〇二六年十月仍未有全盤軍事了結，聯合國與世界銀行對加薩建築受損的評估約在七成上下，數字仍會隨修訂變動。
dataEn: Many of the figures can be checked, though most of them are contested. On the day of the attack Hamas fired about two thousand two hundred rockets from Gaza and some sixteen hundred more from Sinai, plus roughly twenty cruise missiles; the Israeli side reported more than twelve hundred dead and wounded inside the country on the first day, of whom several hundred were military and police personnel, and the tallies do not agree across the different counts. Israeli estimates put the total armed strength of Hamas at about thirty thousand before the war, and the Israeli force in Gaza is commonly estimated to have peaked at around one hundred thousand men. In the action at the Kerem Shalom junction in northern Gaza on 17 and 18 October 2023, units including the 201st Brigade lost thirteen soldiers, the heaviest single loss after the opening day. Of the hostages, two hundred and fifty-one were taken on the first day, about a hundred and twenty were still being held afterwards, and the survivors were released in stages under the framework agreed in October 2025. The war has dragged on without a full military conclusion to this day, and United Nations and World Bank assessments of damage to buildings in Gaza run at around seventy per cent, a figure that keeps being revised.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因要從二〇〇五年說起。以色列當年依據沙姆沙伊赫備忘錄從加薩撤出，哈馬斯於二〇〇七年取得加薩控制權，以色列隨即宣布封鎖並實施軍事接管，加薩從此與外界往來受限。二〇一二年「支柱行動」與二〇一四年「護盾行動」之後，雙方的停火安排與邊境管治爭議始終未解；二〇一八年「偉大歸鄉」示威，以及美國把駐以色列大使館遷往耶路撒冷，令耶路撒冷議題再升溫。二〇二〇年美國提出兩國方案，二〇二一年「謝赫賈拉」拆遷糾紛與年內加薩船隊企圖突破封鎖，令以方認定哈馬斯在為更大一輪攻擊儲備武器。伊朗每年以數千萬美元資金與火箭彈支援哈馬斯，黎巴嫩真主黨亦作協作，使哈馬斯敢於在二〇二三年發動跨國攻擊。直接觸發點是二〇二三年的具體人質交易破裂：哈馬斯要求釋放被以方關押的巴勒斯坦人質，以換取被扣押的以色列人質，談判在七月破裂，同時哈馬斯已完成數千枚火箭彈與數百名滲入者的部署。
causeEn: The origins of this war have to be traced back to 2005. Israel withdrew from Gaza that year under the Sharm el-Sheikh Memorandum, Hamas took control of Gaza in 2007, and Israel declared a blockade and a military administration the same year, cutting the territory off from the outside world. After Operation Pillar of Defense in 2012 and Operation Protective Edge in 2014, the ceasefire arrangements and the question of how the border should be governed were never settled; the Great March of Return in 2018, together with the American move of its embassy to Jerusalem, pushed the Jerusalem question back to the top of the agenda. Washington put forward a two-state plan in 2020, and in 2021 the Sheikh Jarrah eviction dispute and the attempt by a Gaza flotilla to break the blockade convinced the Israeli government that Hamas was stockpiling for a far larger round of attacks. Iranian funding of tens of millions of dollars a year and supplies of rockets, together with coordination from Hezbollah, gave Hamas the confidence to launch a cross-border attack in 2023. The immediate trigger was the collapse of a concrete hostage exchange in 2023: Hamas demanded the release of Palestinians held in Israeli prisons in return for the Israelis it was holding, the talks broke down in July, and by then Hamas had finished deploying thousands of rockets and several hundred infiltrators.
impact: 影響分戰術、政治與海上三層。戰術上，以軍重拾二〇七〇年代以後最擅長的縱深打擊與工程戰，重新找到對付地道的辦法；哈馬斯的「一把火」式突襲、摩托車突擊與綁架人質的做法，則被各國軍事學院重新研究。政治上，二〇二四年以色列大選之後，內塔尼亞胡聯合政府的裂痕擴大，國防部長與參謀長更替頻繁；二〇二四年國際刑事法院發出逮捕令，二〇二五年敘利亞阿薩德政權垮台、黎巴嫩真主黨被打散，整個「抵抗軸心」的結構在兩年之內崩解。以色列的孤立感同時上升，戰事延續反而令海灣國家與歐洲的立場更分裂。海上，紅海航線自二〇二三年十一月起遭胡塞武裝以反艦飛彈與無人艇襲擊，商船改道好望角，運費與到港時間大幅拉長；同一段海面上，以色列海軍的巡防艦與各國護航編隊組成「先鋒行動」等海上聯盟，證明卡面這種小艦艇在反艦飛彈面前仍然脆弱。
impactEn: The effects run along tactical, political and naval lines. Tactically, the Israeli army returned to the deep strike and engineering warfare it had been best at since the 1970s and worked out again how to deal with tunnels, while the Hamas methods of the opening salvo, motorcycle assault and hostage-taking were taken up for study by military academies everywhere. Politically, the coalition behind Netanyahu split more deeply after the 2024 election, with repeated changes of defence minister and chief of staff; the International Criminal Court issued arrest warrants in 2024, and the fall of the Assad government in Syria in December 2024 and the destruction of Hezbollah's position in Lebanon took apart the whole structure of the so-called axis of resistance within two years. Israel's sense of isolation rose in the same period, and the length of the war widened rather than closed the gap between Gulf states and Europe. At sea, the Red Sea route came under attack from the Houthi movement with anti-ship missiles and unmanned boats from November 2023, merchant ships diverted around the Cape of Good Hope, and freight rates and voyage times stretched badly; on the same stretch of water the Israeli navy and the escort task forces formed coalitions such as Operation Prosperity Guardian, which showed that small warships of the kind on the card remain vulnerable in the age of anti-ship missiles.
result: 結果是軍事上未見分曉，政治上靠停火框架收場。到二〇二六年秋，哈馬斯高層相繼被擊殺：政治領袖哈尼耶於二〇二四年七月三十一日在多哈遇襲身亡，武裝指揮官代夫於二〇二五年七月三十一日在汗尤尼斯被擊殺；以色列則在二〇二四年七月至二〇二五年初相繼攻入加薩城北面、拉法與汗尤尼斯，其後在北面與拉法走廊保留防線。二〇二五年十月雙方達成以釋放人質為核心的協議，餘下在生人質陸續回返，加薩由技術官僚式的過渡行政機構管理，重建與解除武裝的爭議懸而未決，區域局勢在低強度對峙中維持。這場戰爭留下的最大裝備教訓，是二〇二三年以後的無人機與廉價火箭已經能威脅價值以億計的護衛艦，過去鐵甲艦靠裝甲解決「砲打不穿」的辦法不再適用，新的答案是分層攔截、快速機動與分布式火力。
resultEn: The result is a war without a military decision, closed off by a ceasefire framework instead. By the autumn of 2026 the senior Hamas leadership had been killed one after another: the political leader Haniyeh was killed in Doha on 31 July 2024 and the military commander Deif in Khan Younis on 31 July 2025; Israel in turn took northern Gaza City, Rafah and Khan Younis in succession between July 2024 and the early months of 2025, and has since held defensive lines in the north and along the Rafah corridor. In October 2025 the two sides reached an agreement centred on the release of the hostages, the survivors returned in stages, and Gaza came under a technocratic transitional administration, with the arguments over reconstruction and disarmament left unresolved and the regional situation held in a low-intensity standoff. The largest lesson in equipment is that after 2023 cheap drones and rockets can threaten escorts costing hundreds of millions; the ironclad's old answer to the problem of guns that could not be penetrated no longer applies, and the new answer is layered interception, fast manoeuvre and distributed firepower.
